1937, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 207 Cont.
Aug. 4 Margaret Ann Sturdevant - 11 - injured by a germ of ..... at 15 months - abnormal ever since - angelican.
6 Wm. Edington - 59 - Convert, creeping paralysis - off and on about 8 yrs ....
Student ... 3 yrs. in College ... fears loss of
Charles Helmer - 47 - progressive muscular dystrophy coming on for 6 yrs. - quite hopeless ..... now very hopeful ....
Ethel Bishoff.
Page 208
Aug. 11th Mrs. Loretta Curtin - 46 - now confined in Peterboro, Ont. fears operation - enemic
Russell Bambartner - 33 - non catholic in Traverse City % long phone - very serious spinal trouble
Mrs. Louise Yachebusch - 37 - fears abcess on breast - danger of cancer
Mrs. J. Koester - 49 - broken hip, has always had swollen limbs; not fears spinal trouble ...
Jennie Mccullough - 60 - without employment - Rev. Fr. McCul' sister
(these entries are written in another's handwriting)
Aug. 12
Mrs. J. Lietaert - skin disease for 1 - year - needs work as car- penter
Cecelia Pniewski - goiter - and auto accident Mrs. J. Stypinski - does not go to Church -stomach trouble Joseph Tuohey - one lung is abscessed - 40 years old -. Joan Clark - 9 infantile paralysis Wm Clark - 10 - infantile paralysis
Cleo Clark - 14 - sickly. Mary Twomey - injured when born (end of this handwriting)
